slots.title: Home: new-here starter kit
slots.brief: A starter kit laid out like a gift: a fat stack of play-money bills in a paper band stamped with a hololive-blue (#3fb8f5) diamond, a blank lanyard trader badge draped over it, and a tiny ticker screen propped beside it showing a single blue up-arrow. A couple of sparkles. Flat graphic shapes, halftone shading, white and blue with warm paper tones.
slots.notes: Sits at the left end of the 'New here? Everyone starts with $10,000' strip, about 132px wide, vertically centred; hidden on phones. Transparent background, readable silhouette at small size, no numbers on the bills.
